The '''Threndria system''' was located in the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Plant/Legends|plants]] known as [[Threndrian snareflower]]s.<ref name="MandalorianArmor" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Threndria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-15.<ref name="TEA" />
